name: Wavelets and Applications
description:
Basic Fourier Analysis: Fourier Series, convergence of Fourier series,
Riesz Fischer theorem, Fourier transform of square integrable functions, Plancheral formula. 
Time frequency analysis.
Wavelet analysis: Orthogonal bases of wavelets, multi resolution analysis, smoothness
of wavelets, compactly supported wavelets, cardinal spline
wavelets, decomposition and reconstruction algorithms for wavelets, frames,
Riesz Systems, discrete wavelet transform, numerical algorithms, wavelet packets, continuous
wavelet transform, inversion formulas , tensor products of wavelets.
Recent development and applications.
